payload.core_composition_summary: Binary representation to get base powers, then greedy splitting of largest power to reach k terms, then two-pointer greedy adjustment for lexicographically largest.
payload.rationale: Combines bit operations for initialization, greedy expansion via largest-power splitting to minimize max exponent, and two-pointer greedy transformation to boost lexicographic order while preserving count and max.
